cases.buyer_trigger: Oak National Academy procurement / MFL lesson publication
cases.purchased_job: Dual-language timed bilingual captions integrated into video lesson production
cases.money_observed: £66,666 excluding VAT awarded to Happy Scribe 2025, optional per-minute purchases; official UK7 notice
cases.capture_evidence: Buyer paid separately for English + target-language timed files despite principal education-production workflow; award and prior contract confirmed
cases.complete_output: Lesson audio/video, translation glossary -> synchronized approved bilingual captions and appropriate file formats
cases.verification: Timing/syntax and language reviewer QC; human language correctness still assessed
cases.repeat_AI: Reusable speech models transcribe and translate, but advanced bilingual teaching context and accessibility QC require review
cases.AI_build: An AI-built caption pipeline would duplicate vendor's existing Human API embedded in Oak
cases.first_ten_route: Other curriculum publishers/academic production contracts; ten qualifying prospects not named
cases.second_kill: Official buyer explicitly invokes lock-in and disruption as justification for same Happy Scribe supplier; no accessible separate selection advantage
cases.next_attack: Look for buyer actively replacing caption vendor only if new proof exists

cases.buyer_trigger: London Borough of Hackney GIS team / scheduled dataflow updates
cases.purchased_job: Recurring geospatial ETL transform, validate and schedule spatial files to systems
cases.capture_evidence: Authority demonstrably buys independent recurring spatial software rather than making staff do file conversions
cases.complete_output: Multiple council GIS layers -> scheduled validated transformed datasets with reconciliation logs
cases.verification: Schema and topology geometry rules, error counters and identical output for repeated input, but specific source rules vary
cases.repeat_AI: AI can translate a rule from prose but cannot replace deterministic lineage/reproducibility for recurring production
cases.AI_build: AI-built ETL technically feasible with OSS but 1Spatial has purpose-built native validation, lifecycle and trust
cases.first_ten_route: UK councils through procurement notices / ProContract; ten specifically switching not found
cases.second_kill: Only paid for a full, already-existing spatial ETL engine, not a cheap document conversion; incumbent holds dataflow design/integration
cases.next_attack: Only reopen with buyer-side evidence smaller councils actively buy independent ETL despite incumbent pricing

cases.buyer_trigger: Natural England habitat-mapping team / October 2026 geospatial deliverable
cases.purchased_job: England-wide inland rock/scree ecological GIS classification layer, metadata and method report
cases.money_observed: £22,425 awarded to FIRA Software Oct 2026; £41,667 was tender estimate, NOT awarded payment
cases.capture_evidence: Actual buyer award to a separate specialist for desk-only GIS layers; secondary official notice mirror supplies amount and supplier, not proof disbursement
cases.complete_output: Approved geological/topographic/aerial habitat datasets -> publishable classified polygons, metadata, method report
cases.verification: Topological polygons/schema can validate, habitat ecological class needs expert ground truth or scientifically defensible supervised labels
cases.repeat_AI: AI satellite labeling assists, not scientific habitat criteria or classification certainty
cases.AI_build: New code can process rasters in GIS but requires ecological specialist per commissioning job
cases.first_ten_route: Natural England habitat consultants and local ecological offices; first ten comparable buyers unverified
cases.second_kill: Finite one-off publicly procured habitat report, domain-specific scientific judgement, uncertainty and specialized datasets
cases.next_attack: Do not turn this bespoke GIS consultancy into generic annotation SaaS

cases.buyer_trigger: Derby City Council planning authority / city digital twin procurement
cases.purchased_job: Interactive accurately surveyed city-centre 3D model for development control and proposal testing
cases.money_observed: £65,512 awarded 2025-2028 to Digital Urban Ltd, official buyer contract
cases.capture_evidence: Council explicitly buys external city digital model for planning workflow
cases.complete_output: Existing mapping+survey+proposal models -> operated verified 3D city environment integrated into planning assessments
cases.verification: Surface geometry and geolocation measurable; planning assessment interactive and professionally assessed
cases.repeat_AI: Generative AI cannot certify city geometry or legal planning appropriateness from images
cases.AI_build: A new simulation/render package could be made, but official city model already exists and integration is contract core
cases.first_ten_route: UK development control teams at councils; nontrivial procurement and no small accessible ten buyer segment
cases.second_kill: Municipal systems, spatial rights, precision and official planning authority create long-tail integration and support
cases.next_attack: A 3D thumbnail is not the procured digital-twin outcome

cases.buyer_trigger: National Oceanography Centre FMRI programme / project site and creative service
cases.purchased_job: New accessible branded programme website plus on-demand design/animation/marketing services
cases.money_observed: £100,000 excluding VAT contract signed February 2026 with Fruitful Studios Ltd
cases.capture_evidence: Public authority buys outsourced complete digital website and continuing creative team independently
cases.complete_output: Brand strategy and content -> deployed accessible website + ongoing branding and production as requested
cases.verification: Automated WCAG technical checks partial; editorial, design approval and follow-on requests require agency input
cases.repeat_AI: AI can generate pages, but production approval and creative delivery remain professional
cases.AI_build: Founder's 1-person website generator only a slice of indefinite creative-services contract
cases.first_ten_route: Research institutes as prospects, public tenders accessible but supplier already selected
cases.second_kill: Retainer buys relationship, maintenance, unlimited specialist services and account management, not software-only site template

cases.buyer_trigger: Historic Environment Scotland / N-RICH research procurement
cases.purchased_job: Research-led computation-ready heritage digitisation standards, pilot tests and evidence assessment
cases.money_observed: £265,275 awarded 2026; research procurement, not software licence
cases.capture_evidence: Standards definition, consultation with GLAM partners, experimental pilots and skill/cost analysis purchased; not standalone data conversion output
cases.complete_output: Collection samples, standards consultation -> reproducible standards plus research report/partner pilot work
cases.verification: Peer-review and sector consultation not a finite testable file-output oracle
cases.repeat_AI: AI can summarize standards literature but cannot collect partner evidence or own technical research decisions
cases.AI_build: Software automates draft catalogues, not the commissioned standards and stakeholder programme
cases.first_ten_route: Historic-environment public buyer tender lists but few projects and long procurement
cases.second_kill: Large buyer budget is for scientific standards programme not independently deliverable software output
cases.next_attack: Do not confuse R&D budget with entrant's capturable revenue

cases.buyer_trigger: UK/IE hobby family-tree owner / big anniversary genealogy gift
cases.purchased_job: Custom diagram of known family relationships as printable editable tree
cases.money_observed: Fiverr gig reports 69 orders; UK reviews dated 2026 disclose up-to-€50 paid ranges
cases.capture_evidence: Identified UK reviewer paid for finished visual chart instead of generating own, but per-order amount very low
cases.complete_output: Names/relationships or GEDCOM -> reviewable printable PDF/image with correct links
cases.verification: Edges, dates, generation hierarchy and PDF dimensions can be deterministically validated; style preferences remain subjective
cases.repeat_AI: Repeated AI and off-the-shelf GEDCOM renderers produce usable charts at very low effort
cases.AI_build: New generator trivial and free browser tools already render customer data
cases.first_ten_route: Genealogy associations easy to reach; no evidence of high-ticket recurring orders
cases.second_kill: Fiverr buyer pays negligible cost for personal attention, against strong free templates and existing rendering
cases.next_attack: Would need distribution at near-zero CAC; no separate proposition

cases.buyer_trigger: UK wedding couple / personalised vows ahead of wedding
cases.purchased_job: Bespoke authored wedding vows written in couple's authentic voice
cases.money_observed: UK Fiverr vetted seller advertises $225 and 1,600+ total orders; UK buyer reports $100–$200 spend
cases.capture_evidence: Identified UK buyer review with paid price range, not just vendor claim. Pays for voice, interviewing and confidence
cases.complete_output: Personal stories/interview -> emotionally resonant original vow speech accepted by couple
cases.verification: Only buyer's subjective voice/taste is an acceptance oracle
cases.repeat_AI: General AI can repeatedly produce drafts from questionnaire, not give the same reassurance and live human guidance
cases.AI_build: Specialist providers already sell £49 AI writing; separate general writing app no defensible wedge
cases.first_ten_route: UK wedding planners/registrars directory; no ten identified buyers with unmet need
cases.second_kill: Human trust, intimacy and coaching command premium while existing £49 AI option covers DIY
cases.next_attack: No attempt to capture high-touch human speech fee through chatbot

cases.buyer_trigger: UK fantasy tabletop hobbyist / bespoke miniature printable model
cases.purchased_job: Commissioned original detailed printable 3D character STL/OBJ sculpture
cases.money_observed: Seller states 430+ Fiverr completed orders, 69 reviews; per-gig UK payment not independently verified
cases.capture_evidence: Global marketplace completed orders support a purchased digital service but evidence for UK buyers on this exact gig limited; other sculpt gig has UK $600–$800 review
cases.complete_output: Character references -> bespoke multi-angle manifold printable 3D mesh with client style signoff
cases.verification: Mesh integrity, dimensions and printability testable; character likeness/design quality subjective
cases.repeat_AI: AI can generate initial models, but articulation and bespoke style often manually edited
cases.AI_build: Existing generation plus mesh repair workflow available; high-touch sculpt per-order needed
cases.first_ten_route: UK tabletop RPG communities; no first-ten matching willingness or frequent volume
cases.second_kill: Digital high-ticket models exist but bought sculptor's artistic control and potentially recurring correction
cases.next_attack: Do not revive previously killed STL pre-supporting via character sculpt synonym

cases.buyer_trigger: UK memorial community club / commemorative group album
cases.purchased_job: Designer assembles donated photos and text into finished digital photo-book layout
cases.money_observed: UK verified Fiverr review paid $50–$100 for player memorial book; designer UK, 75+ reviewed layout orders
cases.capture_evidence: Explicit UK buyer account and platform displayed paid range independent of seller copy; print is not included
cases.complete_output: Collected photos and stories -> emotionally appropriate press-ready layout/PDF and client revisions
cases.verification: Printer bleed/dimensions and file metadata testable; curation is subjective
cases.repeat_AI: AI-layout and album generation are built into established photo tools; human judges emotional selection
cases.AI_build: Replicating layout technically easy, but design revisions and curation carry buyer value
cases.first_ten_route: UK memorial clubs and family organisers accessible via charities, but one-off budgets and high-touch acquisition
cases.second_kill: Known real UK paid digital output is only $50–$100; separate standalone SaaS cannot take over human consultation margins
cases.next_attack: Do not revive previously founder-rejected funeral tribute media

research_note: Official awarded sums are award values, not invoiced payments. Marketplace review price ranges and order counts are separately graded. No outreach, pilot, build or merge. Competition follow-ups do not count as attempts.
